result.summary: Found 1 layout issue where a restaurant title is prematurely clipped mid-character despite having ample available space.

issues.description: Under 'Popular right now', the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is abruptly clipped mid-character ('Tokumaru Rameı') without an ellipsis, even though there is plenty of empty horizontal space before the star rating on the right.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title container to flex into the available space (e.g., flex: 1 with an appropriate margin before the rating) and apply 'text-overflow: ellipsis' so long names truncate cleanly if they ever exceed the available width.
